test.title: Character strengths (IPIP-VIA)
test.about:
Discover your top character strengths among the 24 strengths of the VIA classification (such as curiosity, kindness, perseverance and humour), grouped into six virtues. Your top five are your "signature strengths": the qualities that feel most like you and give you energy when you use them.

Based on the public-domain IPIP-VIA scales. Short form: 96 questions (4 per strength). Long form: 213 questions, the full IPIP-VIA.
test.instructions: You will see {n} statements. For each one, choose how accurately it describes you as you generally are now, not as you wish to be. There are no right or wrong answers.
test.chart_subtitle: From your strongest to your least used strength (your average answer, 1 to 5).
test.signature_about: These are the strengths that feel most like you. Using them in new ways each day is linked to greater well-being.
test.lesser_about: These are not weaknesses; they are simply the strengths you rely on least right now.
test.note: Strengths are ranked within your own profile, not compared with other people. VIA® is a trademark of the VIA Institute on Character; this test uses the free IPIP-VIA scales and is not affiliated with it.

creativity.name: Creativity
creativity.about: Thinking of new and useful ways to do things.
creativity.tip: Try a new way to do a routine task this week, or start a small creative project.

curiosity.name: Curiosity
curiosity.about: Being interested in everything around you and enjoying exploring.
curiosity.tip: Pick a topic you know nothing about and explore it for 20 minutes, or ask people more questions.

judgment.name: Judgement
judgment.about: Thinking things through, looking at all sides and changing your mind when the evidence calls for it.
judgment.tip: Before a decision, write down the best argument for the other side.

learning.name: Love of learning
learning.about: Mastering new skills and knowledge, on your own or formally.
learning.tip: Set a learning goal for the month, such as a course, a book or a skill.

perspective.name: Perspective
perspective.about: Seeing the big picture and giving wise advice to others.
perspective.tip: When someone asks for help, ask questions that help them find their own answer.

bravery.name: Bravery
bravery.about: Not shrinking from threat, challenge or difficulty; speaking up for what is right.
bravery.tip: Do one thing this week that you have been avoiding because it scares you a little.

perseverance.name: Perseverance
perseverance.about: Finishing what you start and keeping going despite obstacles.
perseverance.tip: Break a big goal into small steps and track your progress daily.

honesty.name: Honesty
honesty.about: Speaking the truth, being genuine and taking responsibility for your feelings and actions.
honesty.tip: Notice small moments when you are tempted to bend the truth, and choose openness.

zest.name: Zest
zest.about: Approaching life with energy and excitement, feeling alive and active.
zest.tip: Do something physical and fun, and notice what activities give you energy.

love.name: Love
love.about: Valuing close relationships, caring and being cared for.
love.tip: Tell someone close to you what you appreciate about them.

kindness.name: Kindness
kindness.about: Doing favours and good deeds for others and taking care of them.
kindness.tip: Do one unexpected kind thing for someone each day this week.

social_intelligence.name: Social intelligence
social_intelligence.about: Being aware of the motives and feelings of others and yourself, and knowing what to do in social situations.
social_intelligence.tip: In your next conversation, focus on noticing the other person's feelings.

teamwork.name: Teamwork
teamwork.about: Working well as part of a group, being loyal and doing your share.
teamwork.tip: Offer help to your team or group on something that is not your job.

fairness.name: Fairness
fairness.about: Treating everyone equally and justly, without letting personal feelings bias decisions.
fairness.tip: When you disagree with someone, try to describe their view fairly first.

leadership.name: Leadership
leadership.about: Organising group activities and encouraging a group to get things done while keeping good relations.
leadership.tip: Volunteer to organise a small event or project.

forgiveness.name: Forgiveness
forgiveness.about: Forgiving those who have done wrong and giving people a second chance.
forgiveness.tip: Think of a small grudge and consider letting it go, for your own peace.

humility.name: Humility
humility.about: Letting your accomplishments speak for themselves and not seeing yourself as more special than you are.
humility.tip: In conversations, listen more than you talk and give credit to others.

prudence.name: Prudence
prudence.about: Being careful about choices, not taking undue risks and not saying or doing things you might regret.
prudence.tip: Before an important decision, sleep on it and consider the consequences.

self_regulation.name: Self-regulation
self_regulation.about: Controlling what you feel and do, being disciplined.
self_regulation.tip: Choose one habit to build and track it every day for three weeks.

appreciation.name: Appreciation of beauty
appreciation.about: Noticing and appreciating beauty and excellence in nature, art and everyday life.
appreciation.tip: Take a slow walk and notice three beautiful things.

gratitude.name: Gratitude
gratitude.about: Being aware of and thankful for good things, and taking time to express thanks.
gratitude.tip: Each evening, write down three things that went well and why.

hope.name: Hope
hope.about: Expecting the best in the future and working to achieve it.
hope.tip: Write about your best possible self in five years, then plan one step toward it.

humor.name: Humour
humor.about: Liking to laugh and tease, bringing smiles to other people.
humor.tip: Use humour to lighten a tense moment or to cheer someone up.

spirituality.name: Spirituality
spirituality.about: Having beliefs about the higher purpose and meaning of life that shape your conduct and give you comfort.
spirituality.tip: Spend a few quiet minutes each day reflecting on what gives your life meaning.
